_game: ViZDoom: Freedoom Phase 2, MAP28 'Grim Redoubt' (full Doom II-style map; COOM engine) -- skill 2
_note: pip install vizdoom. Freedoom (https://freedoom.github.io/) is a free replacement for Doom's game data; Phase 2 (freedoom2.wad, 32 maps MAP01-MAP32) stands in for Doom II. Its WAD ships inside the vizdoom package, which registers every map as VizdoomFreedoom2MAP<nn>-S<skill>-v0, so any of them runs with this config by changing 'game'. The map ends when the player reaches the exit, with reward 1; the scenario's own episode_timeout is 60 minutes. freedoom2.cfg turns the automap buffer on, which puts a second panel next to the screen in render() and logs it every frame, so env_kwargs.automap_buffer_enabled turns it off.
_keys_note: The env's action is MultiBinary over the scenario's buttons (env_kwargs.max_buttons_pressed 0), so 'keys' values are button indices in the scenario's available_buttons order -- freedoom2.cfg: 0=ATTACK, 1=SPEED, 2=STRAFE, 3=USE, 4=MOVE_RIGHT, 5=MOVE_LEFT, 6=MOVE_BACKWARD, 7=MOVE_FORWARD, 8=TURN_RIGHT, 9=TURN_LEFT, 10=SELECT_WEAPON1, 11=SELECT_WEAPON2, 12=SELECT_WEAPON3, 13=SELECT_WEAPON4, 14=SELECT_WEAPON5, 15=SELECT_WEAPON6, 16=SELECT_WEAPON7, 17=SELECT_NEXT_WEAPON, 18=SELECT_PREV_WEAPON. Held keys combine (turn while shooting). The controls the subject sees are a plain 'message' phase; keep its text in sync with 'keys' by hand.
_audio_note: env_kwargs.audio_buffer_enabled turns Doom's sound on: it arrives in obs['audio'], is played through the session's speakers, and is logged per frame. Doom makes 1/35 s of sound per step, so fps * env_kwargs.frame_skip must be 35: the session stops the block otherwise, because sound could not follow the frames.

text: Find your way to the exit of the level. Doors and
switches open when you press E in front of them.
